firmware.title: BK-0010/0011M (eCat)
firmware.author: Mikhail Matveev, Mikhail Revzin
firmware.description: The BK-0010, BK-0010-01 and BK-0011M, with the KNGMD, A16M or SMK-512 disks. Emulated by eCat3; ROMs are built in.
firmware.controls: USB keyboard. F11: file browser, F12: settings; a key at power-on picks the model.
